description: Provenance figure: ARP5 nucleotide occupancy across all deposited structures, pocket burial, and gamma-phosphate subsite availability
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
occ=pd.read_csv("arp5_nucleotide_occupancy_survey.csv")
bur=pd.read_csv("nucleotide_burial.csv"); gam=pd.read_csv("gamma_phosphate_subsite.csv")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(16,6.2), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.25,1,1]})

# Panel A: occupancy survey
ax=axes[0]
occ=occ.sort_values(["group","res_A"])
y=np.arange(len(occ))[::-1]
col=["#2b6b4f" if "ADP" in str(v) or "ATP" in str(v) else "#b3412c" for v in occ.ligands_on_ARP5_chain]
ax.barh(y, occ.res_A, color=col, height=0.72)
for yi,(_,r) in zip(y,occ.iterrows()):
    ax.text(r.res_A+0.06, yi, f"{r.pdb}  {r.journal}", va="center", fontsize=8.2)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([("human " if "human" in g else "yeast ")+p for g,p in zip(occ.group,occ.pdb)], fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("resolution (A)"); ax.set_xlim(0,6.6)
ax.set_title("A. Nucleotide modelled on the ARP5 chain\ngreen = ADP present, red = empty cleft", fontsize=11, loc="left")
ax.axhline(y[occ.group.str.contains("human").sum()]+0.5, color="0.6", lw=1, ls="--")
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# Panel B: burial
ax=axes[1]
lab=[s.split(" (")[0] for s in bur.structure]
c=["#4a4a4a","#1f6f8b","#4a4a4a","#4a4a4a"]
ax.bar(range(len(bur)), bur.mean_protein_atoms_within_8A, color=c)
for i,v in enumerate(bur.mean_protein_atoms_within_8A): ax.text(i,v+0.8,f"{v:.0f}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(bur))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab, rotation=22, ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("protein atoms within 8 A per ligand atom")
ax.set_title("B. Nucleotide burial: ACTR5 pocket is\nas enclosed as actin, Arp4 and Arp8", fontsize=11, loc="left")
ax.set_ylim(0,95)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# Panel C: gamma-phosphate subsite
ax=axes[2]
lab2=[s.split(" (")[0] for s in gam.structure]
c2=["#4a4a4a","#1f6f8b","#4a4a4a","#4a4a4a"]
ax.bar(range(len(gam)), gam["min_dist_to_gammaP_atoms_A"], color=c2)
ax.axhline(2.6, color="#b3412c", ls="--", lw=1.4)
ax.text(3.45, 2.65, "severe clash\nthreshold", color="#b3412c", fontsize=8.5, ha="right")
for i,v in enumerate(gam["min_dist_to_gammaP_atoms_A"]): ax.text(i,v+0.06,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(gam))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab2, rotation=22, ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("min distance to transplanted gamma-phosphate (A)")
ax.set_title("C. The gamma-phosphate subsite is open in ACTR5\n(ATP could bind; catalysis is the missing part)", fontsize=11, loc="left")
ax.set_ylim(0,3.8)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
